sections.heading: Company
sections.body:
Snow Holdings Limited (trading as Snow Holdings and Snow Group) is a private limited company registered in the Republic of Uganda under the Companies Act, 2012.

We are a Ugandan construction and materials supply company, delivering residential, commercial and public works projects, and manufacturing concrete blocks and pavers.
